title: 1Limit
tagline: 1Limit is an iOS app to execute 1Inch limit orders on mobile
description: 1Limit is a streamlined iOS app that brings limit order functionality to DeFi traders on the go. Built specifically for the 1inch Network, it empowers users to set precise entry and exit points for their trades directly from their mobile device. The app combines the great feature of decentralized limit orders that 1Inch offers with an intuitive interface designed for quick, confident trading decisions.
how_its_made: Developed natively in Swift, 1Limit prioritizes a seamless user experience through thoughtful iOS design patterns and gesture-based interactions. The app leverages SwiftUI for responsive, fluid animations that make complex DeFi operations feel effortless, while implementing biometric authentication and secure key management to protect user assets.
